tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Find real YouTube videos on LingoDew for learning Japanese or English, filtered by difficulty level (JLPT N5–N1 for Japanese, CEFR A1–C2 for English), topic and keywords. Returns titles, channels, levels and links to LingoDew video pages with tappable subtitles.

tools.name: channel_stats
tools.description: Measured stats for a YouTube channel in LingoDew's library: its video count, and per level its speaking speed, rank among channels at that level, share of its videos and main topics. Useful for picking channels that suit a learner's level.

tools.name: about_lingodew
tools.description: Product facts about LingoDew, for learning English and Japanese from real YouTube videos in the browser or the apps: features, platforms, pricing and free tier.
